_readme: Java data packs page (/minecraft/java/data-packs), rendered by mc-modpacks.js (same engine as the modpacks page). datapacks: tags are keys from "tags" (filter chips; a pack can have several); img = a 480px square crop in /minecrafticons/datapacks/, icon = the project's Modrinth icon. picks: Vanilla Tweaks packs (icons saved from vanillatweaks.net). launchers: where to get packs. essentials: tools for making your own. links: the link row.

datapacks.name: Terralith
datapacks.desc: Almost 100 new biomes, from realistic to light fantasy, built from vanilla blocks only

datapacks.name: VeinMiner
datapacks.desc: Break one ore and the whole vein comes with it. Saves hours of strip mining

datapacks.name: Dungeons and Taverns
datapacks.desc: Taverns to rest in and dungeons to raid, scattered across the whole world

datapacks.name: Towns and Towers
datapacks.desc: A village and pillager outpost for every biome, plus ships out at sea

datapacks.name: Tectonic
datapacks.desc: Taller mountains, deeper valleys and wilder coasts. Terrain worth climbing

datapacks.name: Incendium
datapacks.desc: A Nether rebuilt with new biomes, brutal castles, tricky mobs and unique weapons

datapacks.name: Nullscape
datapacks.desc: Turns the End into an alien dimension of surreal floating terrain

datapacks.name: Geophilic
datapacks.desc: A subtle overhaul of the Overworld biomes that still feels like vanilla

datapacks.name: Explorify
datapacks.desc: Vanilla-style ruins, camps and crypts that look like Mojang built them

datapacks.name: Structory
datapacks.desc: Atmospheric ruins with a little lore, updated every season

datapacks.name: Trek
datapacks.desc: A big batch of new structures for players who've seen every vanilla one

datapacks.name: Luki's Grand Capitals
datapacks.desc: Villages and illager structures rebuilt to look like real settlements

datapacks.name: Amplified Nether
datapacks.desc: Doubles the Nether's height and cranks its terrain all the way up

datapacks.name: True Ending
datapacks.desc: The Ender Dragon gets new attacks and gets harder the longer the fight runs

datapacks.name: Ender Dragon Fight Remastered
datapacks.desc: A tougher final boss that still plays like vanilla

datapacks.name: From The Fog
datapacks.desc: Herobrine haunts your world, true to the old legend

datapacks.name: Spawn Animations
datapacks.desc: Hostile mobs dig out of the ground or poof into existence when they spawn

datapacks.name: Dynamic Lights
datapacks.desc: Hold a torch and the area around you lights up. Works server side

datapacks.name: Tool Trims
datapacks.desc: Trim your tools and weapons at the smithing table. Almost 2,000 combinations

datapacks.name: Vanilla Refresh
datapacks.desc: 30+ quality-of-life features in one pack, like sitting and a day counter

picks.name: Graves
picks.desc: Die and a grave keeps your items safe until you come back for them.

picks.name: Multiplayer Sleep
picks.desc: One player in bed skips the night. No more waiting on the whole server.

picks.name: Coordinates HUD
picks.desc: Your XYZ and a 24-hour clock above the hotbar, no F3 needed.

picks.name: Armor Statues
picks.desc: A book that poses and edits armor stands in survival.

picks.name: More Mob Heads
picks.desc: Mobs have a chance to drop their head when killed.

picks.name: Timber
picks.desc: Chop the bottom log and the whole tree comes down.

picks.name: Anti Creeper Grief
picks.desc: Creepers still explode, but your builds stay in one piece.

picks.name: Silence Mobs
picks.desc: Name a mob "silence me" and it never makes a sound again.

picks.name: Elevators
picks.desc: Throw an ender pearl on wool to make a lift. Jump up, sneak down.

picks.name: Homes
picks.desc: Set homes and teleport back to them with /trigger.

picks.name: AFK Display
picks.desc: Greys out the name of anyone who hasn't moved in five minutes.

picks.name: Double Shulker Shells
picks.desc: Every shulker drops two shells, so boxes come twice as fast.

launchers.name: Modrinth
launchers.desc: Over 15,000 data packs, filterable by version and sorted by downloads.

launchers.name: Vanilla Tweaks
launchers.desc: Tick the small tweaks you want and download them as one zip.

launchers.name: CurseForge
launchers.desc: A long-running data pack section with its own search and filters.

launchers.name: Planet Minecraft
launchers.desc: Community uploads, from one-line tweaks to full adventures.

essentials.name: Misode's Generators
essentials.desc: Fill in a form for loot tables, recipes or worldgen and get the JSON written for you.

essentials.name: Spyglass
essentials.desc: VS Code extension with autocomplete and error checks for .mcfunction and pack JSON.

essentials.name: Minecraft Wiki
essentials.desc: The reference for every folder, file and pack format number.

essentials.name: MCStacker
essentials.desc: Click together long commands, then paste them into a function file.

essentials.name: Parchrome Mob Summon
essentials.desc: Build /summon commands with gear, riders and drops, ready for a function.

essentials.name: Parchrome Tellraw
essentials.desc: Styled chat messages for your pack's welcome text and alerts.
